rules.statement: A surviving spouse cannot donate property by way of dowry to a married child under the Thesawalamai law.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is to be observed that the mother's right is restricted to infant children, subject to the proviso that she 'takes' that child, meaning thereby, looks after it and lives with it. What is the meaning to be attached to the word 'infant'? One would, I believe, be justified in assuming that according to the customs and habits prevalent at that time, most girls in Jaffna married before they attained majority. Hence-, the use of the word 'infant'. Be that as it may, it seems to me that this provision in regard to dowry of unmarried daughters would not, in any case, be applicable to a married child for, ordinarily, on marriage, that child would leave her parental home and become a member of the household of her husband."
